headerDisplay:
Tuya Wi-Fi IR hubs with temperature/humidity sensor (S09, category wnykq) controlled over the local network (Tuya protocol 3.3, TCP 6668), no cloud.

1. Give each hub a DHCP reservation in your router so its IP never changes.
2. Get the device id and the 16-character local key: create a cloud project at iot.tuya.com, link your Tuya Smart / Smart Life app account to it (Devices → Link App Account), then read the key with `tinytuya wizard` or the API Explorer (Device Management → Query Device Details). The key changes if you re-pair the hub in the app.
3. Learn codes with the bundled CLI (stop Homebridge first, the hub accepts one connection): `TUYA_LOCAL_KEY=<key> tuya-ir-learn --ip <ip> --id <device id>`, press each remote button, and paste the printed base64 codes as buttons below.
4. Coolix air conditioners (Midea, Mirage, Electrolux, Comfort Star...) need no learning: add an AC block to the hub. Test with `tuya-ir-learn ... --ac cool 24 auto` and `--ac off`.

pollInterval.title: Status poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: The hub also pushes changes on its own; the poll is a fallback.

temperatureOffset.title: Temperature offset (°C)
temperatureOffset.description: Added to every temperature reading, e.g. -1.5 if the sensor reads high.

ac.title: Air conditioner (Coolix)
ac.description: Adds a separate HeaterCooler accessory whose IR codes are generated locally, no learning. The AC is only created when it has a name.

protocol.title: IR protocol
protocol.description: Coolix: Midea, Mirage, Electrolux, Comfort Star and other Midea-made units.

toggles.title: Extra remote buttons
toggles.description: Each one is a momentary switch: swing (Oscilar), display (Pantalla), sleep (Modo noche), turbo (Turbo).

extraModes.title: Fan-only and dry switches
extraModes.description: Adds the momentary switches Solo ventilador and Deshumidificar.
